newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine flour mills buy 40,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine flour mills buy 40,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour mills bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Japanese trading firm Mitsubishi Corp, traders said on Friday.

Traders said the flour mills bought 19,040 tonnes of western white wheat at $167 to $168 per tonne, 16,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 13.5 percent protein content at $188 per tonne, and 4,960 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with a 14 percent protein content at $192.5 to $193 per tonne.
"The deal, which was for delivery end of October to November, was finalised late on Wednesday," said one dealer.
Philippine flour mills also bought 41,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat last weekend, said one dealer.
